description_en: Queries the servers on which an application whitelist policy takes effect
description_zh: 查询应用白名单策略生效的服务器
name: DescribeWhiteListEffectiveAssets

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. It is automatically obtained by the system
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The condition that is used to query assets. You can enter an IP address, a public IP address, an private IP address, or an asset name for fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 资产检索项。可填写资产的IP、公网IP、内网IP、资产名称进行模糊匹配
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the policy.

You can call the [DescribeWhiteListStrategyList](~~DescribeWhiteListStrategyList~~) operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
策略编号。
调用[DescribeWhiteListStrategyList](~~DescribeWhiteListStrategyList~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: strategy_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the number of untrusted programs. Valid values:

0: no
1: yes
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要返回资产不可信程序异常启动的异常行为数量。取值：
0：否
1：是
parameters.name: need_statistics

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 1000. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 data entries are returned per page.

We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。最大值为1000，每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

Assets.description_en: The servers on which the policy takes effect
Assets.description_zh: 生效的服务器信息列表

items.description_en: The server on which the policy takes effect

InternetIp.description_en: The public IP address of the server

ProcessMethod.description_en:
The exception handling mode. Valid values:

0: unhandled
1: alerted
2: blocked
ProcessMethod.description_zh:
异常处理模式。取值：
0：不处理
1：告警
2：阻断

SuspiciousEventCount.description_en: The number of untrusted programs on the server
SuspiciousEventCount.description_zh: 服务器存在的不可信程序异常启动的异常行为数量

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page
Count.description_zh: 分页查询时，显示的当前页的数据条数

CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的数据的最大条数

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of the servers on which the policy takes effect
